claim_en: GTA 6 releases Thursday November 19 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S
Take-Two reaffirmed the Nov 19 date in its Nov 9 earnings
Unlock is at midnight local time region by region; New Zealand gets it first
US PlayStation Store unlock: Nov 18 9 PM PT / midnight ET
No PC / Switch 2 / mobile version announced
US price: Standard $79.99 / Ultimate $99.99; no collector's edition
EU price 79.99 EUR / UK 69.99 GBP (secondary sources only)
Pre-orders opened June 25 2026; bonus Vintage Vice City Pack + 1 month GTA+
Physical edition has NO disc - only a download code in the box
Preload live since Nov 10; Rockstar recommends up to 212 GB free space
PS5 package is 223 GB (dataminers - not corroborated); their 'firmware 14.22 required' detail was wrong - Sony requires 14.23 (see F119)
Launch is single-player; no GTA 6 Online announced
Zelnick: pre-orders tracking far in excess of initial expectations
Sensor Tower estimate: 7.71M digital pre-orders (~$751M) as of Nov 3
9.69M pre-orders (~$942M) as of Nov 10 - no primary Sensor Tower source found
About 90% of pre-orders are Ultimate Edition
Take-Two FY guidance raised to $7.98B-$8.18B
Trailer 1 released Dec 4 2023 (a day early after a leak)
Delayed twice: fall 2025 -> May 26 2026 -> Nov 19 2026
Trailer 2 released May 6 2025
Extended Look (~26 min gameplay) premiered on Netflix Aug 27 2026
Launch Trailer released Oct 15 2026
An official "Trailer 3" was released - no video has that name
Game Awards 2026 nominees revealed Nov 17 12 PM ET: GTA 6 was eligible (cutoff Nov 20 9 PM PT) and got 8 nominations incl. Game of the Year

Review embargo lifted Nov 18 - Make Tech Easier reports 11:00 UTC (6 AM ET / 3 AM PT = midnight Nov 19 in New Zealand); critic reviews (GameSpot / Kotaku / Forbes / PC Gamer) were live before 12:30 UTC
Playable duo Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos; Lucia is released from Leonida Penitentiary
State of Leonida (Florida-inspired): Vice City / Leonida Keys / Grassrivers / Port Gellhorn / Ambrosia / Mount Kalaga
Rockstar devs in previews: map is roughly twice the size of GTA 5
Map is "3x Red Dead Redemption 2"
Switch between Jason and Lucia almost anytime; relationship choices affect the story
Criminal Profile system rates you from Professional to Irredeemable
RydeMe rideshare app acts as fast travel
Lana Del Rey and Morgan Wallen host Back Country Radio
About 100 missions across 5 chapters (reviewer via Insider Gaming) - post-launch guides count 90-91 (see F141)

PC version in Q1 2027 (GamesBeat / 4 anonymous sources) - still no Rockstar announcement as of Nov 28; Take-Two says any PC news will come from Rockstar and is meanwhile taking down unofficial PC ports (F229); a newer GameGPU claim of PC in March 2027 together with GTA 6 Online is unconfirmed (F238)
GTA 6 Online expected sometime in 2027 - no Rockstar date (Schreier says a 'later' Bloomberg phrasing was wrong) - nothing new at launch
Some physical boxes arrive with missing or already-used codes - scale unknown and no Rockstar fix announced
You can read the code through the box with a flashlight
GTA 6 delayed again to 2027 - the game launched Nov 19 2026 (F118); a fake Rockstar letter claiming a 2027 delay (Instagram Nov 16 / tagged 'ragebait') was debunked by Lead Stories
"Download GTA 6 for PC" / GTA 6 APK / playable leaked build (malware per ESET)
Cyberleek released the full playable game - he posted an alleged Nov 2026 Xbox build (~200 GB per his own claim) but says he withheld the executable so it cannot run; nothing is verified (see F192)
AI-generated GTA 6 gameplay leaks (8M+ views - creator admitted joke)
Vice City bridge leak (creator showed how he faked it)
A disc version is coming in a few months
The physical box lets you play early
The viral "Miami Beach real or GTA 6?" clip is real GTA 6 footage reshared by Rockstar
Zelnick: generative AI has no part in GTA 6
YouTube 24-hour GTA 6 launch livestream starting midnight ET Nov 19

Three updates as of Nov 28 07:15 UTC: 1.002.000 (Nov 13) and 1.002.001 (Nov 16 / ~602 MB on PS5 - Kotaku calls it the day-one patch) shipped with no notes; 01.002.002 on PS5 / 1.0.2.2 on Xbox released Nov 23 is the first post-launch patch and the first with public patch notes (~604 MB on PS5 / ~1.6 GB on Xbox - see F206); no newer patch found from Nov 26 to Nov 28 morning (no 01.002.003 in any tracker) and nothing shipped on Nov 25 (F173)
Update 1.002.001 is ~602.5 MB on PS5 and ~1.6 GB on Xbox; 1.002.000 was ~1 GB PS5 / ~2.2 GB Xbox (dataminers)
Rockstar: GTA 6 targets 30 fps on every console incl. PS5 Pro; Pro gets PSSR and ray-traced shadows
A hidden 60 fps mode exists in the game files (dataminer claim - no mode announced)
Sony and Microsoft: GTA 6 is the most pre-ordered game in PlayStation Store and Microsoft Store history (no numbers given)
Sensor Tower estimate: over 12M digital pre-orders through Nov 13 (reported by CNBC)
About 15M pre-orders and $1.45B as of Nov 16 (third-party trackers citing Sensor Tower - no primary source)
"Rockstar confirmed $1B in pre-orders" - Rockstar and Take-Two published no figure; all totals are estimates
Morgan Stanley forecasts 40M copies sold by March 2027 (analyst estimate)
Xbox Cloud Gaming streams GTA 6 from 1 AM ET Nov 19 (06:00 UTC) on Xbox One and Series X|S; you must own the game; no PC streaming (opening not yet verified live)
GTA 6 is included in Game Pass or PS Plus - it is sold separately
Mainland Europe (FR/DE/ES/IT) unlocks Nov 18 23:00 UTC; UK / Ireland / Portugal Nov 19 00:00 UTC (midnight local rule)
Free printable Leonida map and cover poster on the official site Nov 19; double-sided print $0.99 at Rockstar Store shortly after launch
Guardian interview: scout stores before robbing them; some parked cars need tools like a key cloner or slim jim
PS5 retail codes are region-locked; Japanese box codes expire 170 days after launch
A viewer redeemed a streamer's GTA 6 code shown on a TikTok live (unverified)
"Public beta / paid VIP early access" - no beta or early access exists; these are scams
Viral 676.7 GB install size - Rockstar says up to 212 GB
"Sony warned PSN will crash at launch" - PS Blog only cited unprecedented demand; no outage warning
YouTube stream: RDCWorld pre-show 11 PM ET Nov 18; ~30 creators; ends live from Miami
Miami Heat play as the Vice City Heat vs the Bucks on Nov 18 (A Night in Vice City) with custom court and jerseys
"Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival" - Rockstar x PlayStation concert Nov 21 at Mana Wynwood Miami (lottery closed)
Festival lineup includes Travis Scott / Cardi B / Metro Boomin / Justice (reported - full bill not official)
Squeezie posts his GTA VI IRL video "escape 6 stars" Nov 17 at 6 PM Paris with Inoxtag / Amine / Mister V
GTA 6 is nominated for Game of the Year at The Game Awards 2026
TGA 2026 Game of the Year nominees: 007 First Light / Control Resonant / Grand Theft Auto VI / Phantom Blade Zero / Resident Evil Requiem / The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
GTA 6 has 8 nominations: Game of the Year; Best Game Direction; Best Narrative; Best Art Direction; Best Score and Music; Best Audio Design; Best Performance; Best Action/Adventure Game
Manni L. Perez is nominated for Best Performance as Lucia - the nomination officially reveals Lucia's actor
GTA 6 is the first game nominated for Game of the Year at The Game Awards before its release
GTA 6 is the most nominated game of TGA 2026 with 8; Nintendo is the most nominated publisher with 12
The Game Awards 2026 airs Thursday Dec 10 at 7:30 PM ET / 4:30 PM PT (Dec 11 00:30 UTC)
Eligibility: games must be on sale by Friday Nov 20 2026 9 PM PT - GTA 6 (Nov 19) qualifies with one day to spare
Keighley denies TGA changed its dates for GTA 6 - he says the calendar is set the same way every year
TGA pushed its deadline back to Nov 20 to let GTA 6 in - the cutoff is routinely the Friday before Thanksgiving (Nov 22 2024 / Nov 21 2025)
TGA winners are decided 90% by a global media jury and 10% by fan vote - fan voting is open on thegameawards.com
GTA 6's 8 nominations are not a record - the TGA record is 12 (Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 in 2025)
Exact embargo hour: Make Tech Easier reports 11:00 UTC Nov 18 - matches Insider Gaming's earlier table (11:00 GMT / 6 AM ET / 3 AM PT); Rockstar never published an official hour

"GTA 6 got a mixed 6.5 on Metacritic" - it was a user score from 5 ratings with no written review posted Nov 16 before anyone could play; no critic review was out (critic Metascore opened at 99 on Nov 18 - see F105)
PS Store backend shows about 12 GTA 6 ratings averaging 4.67/5 before launch (PS Store DB / dataminer) - not public reviews and not a Metacritic score
Review copies show a flashing reviewer-name watermark (ManaByte) - denied by NateTheHate and Tom Henderson; Rockstar silent
GTA VI: The Album 34-track tracklist leaked via photos of early-sold vinyl (Nov 14-15); Rolling Stone and Billboard sources say it is accurate; Rockstar has not confirmed
Sony released PS5 system software 26.07-14.22.00 with one patch note (security fixes) - superseded on Nov 17 by 26.07-14.23.00 which Sony says is required for GTA 6 (see F119)
Preload night Nov 9-10 drove ~10x console traffic at some German ISPs and PS Store / account pages were partly down

Pre-launch "working GTA 6 cheat codes" lists - nobody could play before Nov 19 and many recycled GTA 5 codes; real GTA 6 cheats only surfaced at launch and unlock after the story (see F129); cheat generators are scams
Cheats return in GTA 6 like in every mainline GTA since GTA III - confirmed at launch by the PC Gamer and GameSpot cheat guides (see F129)
Vice City Heat vs Milwaukee Bucks tips off Nov 18 at 7 PM ET (Nov 19 00:00 UTC) at Kaseya Center on ESPN; Vice City jerseys by Rockstar x Cactus Jack x Nike
YouGov survey for PCMag: about 12.5M US adults plan to take time off or rearrange work or school for GTA 6 (survey extrapolation)
GTA 6 is current-gen only (PS5 / Xbox Series X|S) - GTA 5 launched on PS3 / Xbox 360 in 2013 and was re-released on two later console generations
Rockstar (to Edge): Leonida's landmass is nearly as large as the GTA 4 + GTA 5 + Red Dead Redemption 2 maps combined
Rockstar's Aaron Garbut (to Edge): GTA 6 has an order of magnitude more interiors than Rockstar's previous games
Two playable leads (Jason and Lucia) vs three in GTA 5 (Michael / Franklin / Trevor)
Wanted level goes back up to 6 stars - GTA 5 capped it at 5
GTA 6 launches with no online mode and no online date - GTA 5's GTA Online went live about two weeks after the game (Oct 1 2013)
Standard Edition is $79.99 vs $59.99 for GTA 5 at launch in 2013 (+$20 before inflation)
GTA 6 targets 30 fps on all consoles (F051) while GTA 5's 2022 PS5 / Series X version has a Performance mode targeting 60 fps
Like GTA 5 (PC about 18 months after consoles) GTA 6 launches without a PC version and Rockstar has given no PC date

Metascore still 99 in every Nov 19-20 report (tied with Ocarina of Time); review counts differ by snapshot (Kotaku 145 / GameSpot 147 / up to ~153 on PS5 late Nov 18) and the lowest critic score is 90; Metacritic page not reachable from the studio
OpenCritic rates GTA 6 Mighty; Critics Recommend reported between 99% and 100% depending on the snapshot (100% at the first Nov 18 check) - no newer snapshot found Nov 20
OpenCritic Top Critic Average now reported as 99 by most roundups (98 at earlier checks) from 76 to 89 reviews as the count rises - live page not checked
GameSpot review (Tamoor Hussain): 10/10 - Setting The Bar For Open Worlds Impossibly High
IGN review (Luke Reilly): 10/10 - reported by Tom's Guide and Vice roundups; IGN page not reached
The Guardian review (Keza MacDonald): 5/5 - reported by T3 / Tom's Guide / Vice roundups; Guardian page not reached
Eurogamer review: 5/5 - reported by review roundups; Eurogamer page not reached
Game Informer review: 10/10 - reported by Tom's Guide roundup; Game Informer page not reached
VGC review: 5/5 in most roundups (one site says 10/10) - VGC page not reached
Recurring praise: open-world detail and freedom set a new bar - GameSpot also calls the heist missions the highlight of the gameplay
Recurring criticism: frame-rate dips in the busiest moments (GameSpot: only in extreme six-star wanted chases) and some progression requirements that slow the pacing (GameSpot via Forbes)
"GTA 6 beat every game ever on Metacritic" - its 99 still ties The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (99 from 22 reviews) and is not a solo record (re-checked Nov 19)
No critic gave GTA 6 a score below 9/10 on Metacritic at first count - one of the lowest is PlayStation LifeStyle at 90
GTA 6 is out: it unlocked at midnight local time on Nov 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S - the US East Coast and Canada went live at 05:00 UTC
Sony requires PS5 system software 26.07-14.23.00 (~1.2 GB / released Nov 17) to play GTA 6 even if you preloaded - PlayStation Support US said so on X; its patch notes only cite security fixes
The mandatory 14.23 firmware is meant to block a recent PS5 jailbreak (Notebookcheck speculation - Sony gave no reason)
PlayStation Network outage on Nov 18 afternoon ET hours before launch - Sony's status page showed it resolved by about 2:30 PM ET; DownDetector peaked above 1800 reports
UK broadband provider YouFibre said GTA 6 download demand caused a network capacity issue that slowed its customers
Sensor Tower estimate on launch eve: 17.07M units pre-purchased (~$1.65B gross) - 12.73M on PS5 and 4.35M on Xbox Series X|S (about 75/25)
Forecasts: Sensor Tower projects up to 25M pre-purchases by launch and M Science about 26M copies through launch day

"Rockstar has sold 17 million copies before release" - the 17M figure was a Sensor Tower estimate of digital pre-orders; the official Take-Two / Rockstar pre-release figure published Nov 20 is 32.5M units (F166)
Ultimate Edition bonuses unlock progressively as you advance through the story chapters (Rockstar's edition description) - not all at launch; some fans call it 'scam of the year'
Some early Ultimate bonuses (Jason's Dinka Enduro and Crest Kayak) expire after Chapter 1 and most extras arrive in Chapter 2 which may take 25+ hours

Digital Foundry: Xbox Series S runs GTA 6 at about 720p and often below 30 fps (mid-20s in combat / ~20 fps in the heaviest scenes) while Series X holds about 1440p at 30 fps; DF suggests another console if you can - no Rockstar response or Series S patch announced as of Nov 22 (VGC also reports significant frame drops)
GTA 6 has cheats: D-pad codes on PS5 / Xbox that unlock only after you finish the main story plus a challenge for each cheat (PC Gamer and GameSpot guides)
Money cheat ($250000): Up-Right-Down-Left-Up-Left-Down-Right on the D-pad (PS5 / Xbox) - unlocked by finishing the story; same input on GameSpot + PC Gamer + GamesRadar

Infinite Ammo cheat: Down-Up-Right-Down-Left-Left-Up-Down-Down-Down on the D-pad (PS5 / Xbox) - unlocked by winning 25 silver-or-better shooting range medals; same input on GameSpot + PC Gamer + GamesRadar (Kotaku ends with Up - likely a mix-up with No Reload)

About 61 cheats in total (G2A / Red Bull / AlcastHQ) - no outlet from our reliable list gives a total and several inputs are still unknown; Max Ammo requirement still conflicts (20 bronze medals per PC Gamer vs 25 per PowerPyx / Destructoid)
To enter a cheat: open the phone with the D-pad then hold L1+R1 (LB+RB on Xbox) and input the code on the D-pad - same method on PS5 and Xbox (GamesRadar + Kotaku + PC Gamer)
GTA 5 cheats (PAINKILLER / TURTLE / 1-999 phone numbers) work in GTA 6 - GTA 6 uses its own new D-pad codes that unlock after the story (GameSpot / PC Gamer lists)
Weird Al Yankovic is a DJ in GTA 6 - he co-hosts Vice City FM (80s hits); Rockstar confirmed it to Kotaku; his own songs are not on the station
GTA 6 explains why you hear police radio chatter: Jason installs a homebrew police scanner app on his phone (Kotaku)
A literal painted Easter egg sits in a nest on top of Vice City's tallest radio tower (a six to seven minute climb) and can be thrown (GameSpot + Kotaku)
A Dexter Morgan apartment reference can be visited on Washington Island in Vice City (GameSpot easter egg list)
The Skunk Ape (Florida's Bigfoot) can be found in the swamps through a side questline (PC Gamer + VGC + GameSpot + Kotaku)
A dog in sunglasses on a jet ski rescues players stranded far offshore (viral player claim - only seen in aggregated reports; Windows Central shows players jet-skiing with dogs)
The main story has more than 90 missions across five chapters - PC Gamer counts 91 and GamesRadar's mission list says 90+ (two reliable outlets); Rockstar has published no official mission count
NordVPN found a dark-web 'GTA 6 scam kit' (~$200 in crypto) built on a fake PC release - its CTO: 'There is no PC version on November 19. If you see one it's a scam'
On OpenCritic GTA 6's Top Critic Average (98-99) is reported as the site's highest ever - ahead of Super Mario Odyssey (97) - live page not checked
Take-Two stock rose about 6% after the reviews (TrendingTopics - not checked against market data)
The $99.99 Ultimate Edition gives early access - every edition unlocks at the same midnight local time and the Ultimate extras unlock through the story chapters (see F003 / F126)
A second PSN / PS Store hiccup about 30 minutes after the US launch (TalkEsport - not confirmed by Sony)

Sensor Tower estimate by the end of launch day (Nov 19): about 24.6M digital copies and ~$2.36B gross incl. pre-orders - PS5 about 75%; not a Take-Two figure (Take-Two's official figure published Nov 20 is $3.79B - see F165)
Sensor Tower estimate on launch morning (via Reuters): 19.1M units and ~$1.84B - headlines compare it with GTA 5's ~$800M first day (a Take-Two figure from 2013)

Official numbers are out: on Nov 20 Rockstar / Take-Two announced $3.79B in day-one retail sales and 32.5M units sold pre-release (F165 / F166); still no newer official figure (no weekend total) / no player count / no platform split / no digital-vs-boxed split from Rockstar / Take-Two / Sony / Microsoft as of Nov 28 07:15 UTC - the 44.9M weekend figure is an Alinea Analytics estimate (F210) and the only new data points are the UK boxed chart No. 1 with no unit figure (F218) and no Japan Famitsu figure yet (F234); the UK week-2 chart and Circana's US November report are not out yet
Rockstar / Take-Two confirmed $1.84B or $2.36B in day-one sales - both are Sensor Tower estimates; the official Take-Two figure (Nov 20) is $3.79B in day-one retail sales (F165)
Streams Charts: GTA 6 launch streams peaked at about 7.88M concurrent viewers within ~3 hours of release (Twitch / YouTube / Kick) - viewers not players
Live 'GTA 6 player count' trackers show official numbers - Sony / Microsoft / Rockstar publish no per-game player counts and two trackers differ by millions at the same time (about 1.7M vs 7.1M)

Crash / softlock / missing-texture and audio bug reports on PS5 and Xbox - the PS5 crash is covered by GameSpot and GamesRadar (see F172); Rockstar's Nov 23 patch notes now say it fixed several crash issues (F206) without naming them so the overall scale and what remains are unknown (unofficial bug trackers only)

Viral 'unofficial GTA 6 PC port' video - XDA shows it splices GTA 6's title screen with older footage of GTA 5 running on PC; there is no PC version (F005 / F142); the claim is resurfacing after Take-Two's takedown of unofficial port projects (F229 / F230)
Pocket cash is lost if you get Wasted or Busted - deposit it at ATMs into your BuckMe bank account (GamesRadar + GameSpot + PC Gamer)

Money details from one reliable outlet each: pocket cash is accepted for purchases up to $1000 only (GamesRadar); death or arrest costs a few hundred dollars and early cash can be hidden under the bedroom floorboards of the Key Lento house (PC Gamer) - the $20000 pocket cap is now confirmed separately (F175)
Bank and loan-store cash carries dye packs that go off if you flee too far - you need a Dye Pack Jammer before bank jobs pay (GameSpot + VGC; GameSpot says it comes in Chapter 3)
Fastest in-game money per the GameSpot / PC Gamer / GamesRadar / VGC guides: robberies (stores early then banks) plus selling stolen cars and goods through fences and buyers
Demolition derbies at Ambrosia Raceway pay $3800-$6300 per win (PC Gamer only)
Some story missions stay locked until you have enough money (GamesRadar - one reliable outlet; GameSpot's review also flags progression requirements - see F115)

No full first-person mode at launch and still no official mode or update announced as of Nov 24 (the Nov 23 patch notes do not mention it - F208): hold L2/LT to zoom then click L3+R3 for a temporary first-person view in some moments (not while driving) and scoped weapons give first-person aiming (GamesRadar + VGC + GameSpot + PC Gamer)

A player-found glitch (camera button remapped to the touchpad then the phone used in a car) gives a fuller first-person view - unofficial and still buggy; tested by PC Gamer and reported by GamesRadar (also Dexerto / GamingBolt / PlayStation LifeStyle); Rockstar has not said whether it will patch it
VGC tip: switch on HGiG in your HDR TV's game mode then set HDR on the console and only then in the game (one reliable outlet)
Using a cheat blocks saving from that point (PC Gamer) and disables trophies / achievements for the session (Kotaku) - each point from one reliable outlet plus PowerPyx

Rockstar / Take-Two press release (Nov 20): GTA 6 made $3.79B in day-one retail sales worldwide (company estimate through the end of Nov 19) - called the biggest entertainment launch in history across any medium; no newer official figure (no weekend total) as of Nov 28 - Alinea's ~$4B weekend figure is an analyst estimate (F210)

Same release: GTA 6 sold 32.5M units pre-release across all platforms - a record per Take-Two (also furnished to the SEC as an 8-K exhibit); no updated unit total as of Nov 28; GTA 6 debuted No. 1 on the UK GfK boxed chart but no unit figure was published (F218) and no Japan Famitsu figure found yet (F234)
Rockstar's own past launches for scale: GTA 5 made about $800M on day one (2013) and Red Dead Redemption 2 about $725M in its opening weekend (2018) - GTA 6's $3.79B is nearly five times GTA 5
GTA 6's 32.5M pre-release units top Elden Ring's 30M copies sold in about three years (GamesRadar comparison)
Kotaku: GTA 6's $3.79B in 24 hours beats Avengers: Endgame's lifetime box office (about $2.8B-$2.9B) by nearly $1B - caveat: game retail sales vs film ticket sales are different measures

The official release gives no split by console / digital vs boxed / pre-orders vs day-one buys and no player numbers - Sensor Tower's lower $2.36B covered digital sales only (VGC / PC Gamer / GameSpot coverage)

Take-Two's $3.79B is fake because Sensor Tower said $2.36B - both exist but measure different things: Sensor Tower estimated digital sales only while Take-Two's company figure covers worldwide retail sales (F165 / F170)

Some PS5 players report GTA 6 crashing to the home screen with error CE-108255-1 (a generic Sony app-error code - some Xbox crashes too); the Nov 23 patch says it fixes several issues that caused crashes (F206) but does not name this error and Rockstar has made no statement on CE-108255-1 as of Nov 28 (no patch since Nov 23) - Rockstar's support page sends console errors to Sony / Xbox and Sony's advice is to update the game (GameSpot + Dexerto + GamesRadar + Notebookcheck)

Rockstar apologized for lag and shipped a major fix on Nov 25 (viral X post since Nov 20) - no patch arrived on Nov 25 and Rockstar posted no apology: the latest update is still 01.002.002 from Nov 23 (a small bug-fix patch with no apology - F206 / F049) and patch trackers list no later entry as of Nov 26 07:15 UTC; PC Games Hardware and GTA6Track found no announcement on Rockstar's channels; original post: https://x.com/GoofysExe/status/2123188059344965774

An official first-person mode could come in a later update (Kotaku says Rockstar earlier hinted at it; GTA 5 only got first-person in its 2014 re-release) - no Rockstar announcement as of Nov 24 and the Nov 23 patch notes are silent on it
Jason and Lucia can each carry up to $20000 in pocket cash - anything above stays in the bank (GamesRadar + PC Gamer)
Main story length per reliable outlets: about 45-60 h (Kotaku reviewers) / ~60 h (VGC) / 65+ h (GameSpot) / 60-80 h (GamesRadar); 100 h or more with most side content (VGC / GameSpot)
Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson said his own playthrough took about 80 hours incl. some optional goals (GamesRadar + GameSpot)
For comparison GTA 5's main story averages about 31.5 hours on HowLongToBeat (user-submitted average) - roughly half GTA 6's 60-80 h outlet estimates
Flipped car? Walk into its side and click / hold L3 to push it back on its wheels - it can fail if the car is too heavy or you run out of stamina (Kotaku + PC Gamer)
Petting dogs and cats (hold L2/LT to focus on them) boosts your Focus - GamesRadar ties the bonus to a Professional criminal profile (Kotaku + GamesRadar)
You can erase a one-star wanted level by talking to the cop: hold L2/LT on the officer with no gun out and pick defuse (Kotaku only)
Shortcuts: double-tap exit to leave the engine and lights on / double-tap D-pad left to toggle the radio / double-tap Circle-B to cycle headlights (Kotaku shortcut guide - second outlet not verified)
Brian O'Conner's Fast and Furious Mitsubishi Eclipse sits in a garage on Vespucci Island and can be taken in every edition (GamesRadar only)
Rockstar's launch Newswire post (Nov 19) says GTA 6 is available worldwide on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S and asks players to avoid spoiling the story for others
GTA 6 is out on Nintendo Switch 2 - the viral image is a satire mash-up of the cover art with Nintendo branding; the game is only on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S (F005 / F184)

GTA+ ($7.99 a month) now adds perks to GTA 6's single-player: a widebody '90 Annis Venturas BLVD Elegy and a one-car Crosstown garage with a weapon locker (from Chapter 3) plus 10% off at some shops / free bike-scooter-Seashark rentals and transit / 10% more when selling owned vehicles (GameSpot + GamesRadar + PC Gamer + TrueAchievements + Polygon); Rockstar's public GTA+ page still lists only GTA Online perks as of Nov 23
GTA+ story perks (car / garage / discounts) stop working if you cancel the subscription (TrueAchievements - other outlets say Rockstar has not confirmed it; still no Rockstar statement Nov 23)

The pre-order free month of GTA+ auto-renews at $7.99 a month unless you cancel it before it ends (Push Square + Insider Gaming); GTA+ boosts can be switched off in the pause menu Account tab (reported)

Heat system: red icons under the stars show what the police know about you (face / clothing / vehicle / weapon / accomplice / CCTV); hiding your weapon / changing clothes / swapping the car / splitting from your partner removes that Heat - Rob Nelson says Rockstar wanted police with a more persistent memory (GamesRadar + GameSpot + VGC)
At six stars you can no longer lose the Heat - there is no way to resolve it until you are caught or killed (GamesRadar + PC Gamer)

Star colours: black and white = police investigating / grey = they know who you are / white = chasing you in sight / red = out of sight but they hold info (GamesRadar inferred it from preview footage - unofficial)

Cyberleek posted an alleged Nov 2026 Xbox build of GTA 6 (~200 GB) but withheld the executable and ties its release to a crypto token price - unverified; files sold as Cyberleek builds are linked to malware (Kotaku / VGC / Notebookcheck) - studio rule: no Cyberleek images or content

"Lens" claim: a self-styled fired Rockstar engineer says GTA 6 secretly profiles players through the PS5 controller and sells the data via 'Vantage Analytics' - no such firm appears in Take-Two's SEC filings / no news outlet has reported it / Rockstar's disclosed data collection includes no psychological profiling (fact-check; X flags it as a fabricated hoax); a newer variant says the profiles go to insurers and employers and Notebookcheck finds no proof

There is no Disney World or Universal-style theme park in GTA 6 - Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson explained the team lacked the time to build one and the story gave Jason and Lucia no reason to visit (VGC + Dexerto + Kotaku + Notebookcheck) - the original GTA Vice City only advertised a parody park called Fun World

GTA 6 has a secret Disney World / Universal parody theme park - Rockstar's Rob Nelson said there is none and explained why (F194); pre-launch Rockstar answers to Game Informer had already pointed away from real-world parks

GTA 6's Metacritic user score has been review-bombed since user ratings opened at launch - reported between about 4.9 and 5.6 out of 10 (tens of thousands of ratings) while the critic Metascore stays 99 (F105); Metacritic lets anyone rate without owning the game and many negative reviews admit they never played it (OpenCritic + GGRecon + Men's Journal - live page not checked); no newer user score found Nov 25 (secondary reports still cite about 4.9) and no report that Metacritic removed post-launch ratings (it only removed pre-launch fakes - F086)

Players hate GTA 6 - its real score is 5 out of 10 - that number is an open Metacritic user score anyone can post without owning the game and many low ratings admit they never played; critics give 99 (F105) and Take-Two reports a record $3.79B day one (F165); store ratings that require owning the game are reported near 4.8 out of 5 (single secondary source)

A house pictured in a photo added to GTA San Andreas The Definitive Edition in 2021 exists in GTA 6 in Belville (Leonida) - found by a mapping-community player at launch; the photo was not in the 2004 original (Kotaku + VGC + Dexerto + Notebookcheck) - Rockstar has not commented; VGC calls it likely our real first look at GTA 6
In GTA 6 you can listen to the radio and podcasts on foot - not only in vehicles as in GTA 5 (Rockstar via VGC + GameSpot)

Radio count: PC Gamer lists about 19-20 music stations plus 2 unlockable ones (The Sniper of La Perle hosted by Kodak Black and The Vault) plus talk channels - VGC's list differs so there is no agreed total and Rockstar gave none
Leonida has more than 170 animal species - about 60 of them birds and over 30 land mammals plus fish and reptiles (Rockstar via Game Informer - reported by GameSpot + Dexerto)

Hunting is a Jason-only activity introduced by Bret Vogel near Mount Kalaga who buys carcasses in Pristine or Good condition - a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine; guides add that the intro quest Veteran Hunted starts in Chapter 2 and pays $500 with 15 more hunting jobs after it (Dexerto wiki + theclick.gg + PowerPyx + GTABase; GamesRadar only confirms hunting pays cash) - still not two reliable outlets (re-checked Nov 25)

An Arthur Morgan-style cowboy hat (Red Dead Redemption 2 nod) can be bought at a Port Gellhorn yard sale reachable in Chapter 2 - one guide says $35 as 'Genuine Cowboy Hat' (TheGamer + Gfinity - game never names Arthur)

Arion Kurtaj (21) pleaded guilty on Nov 16 2026 at Woolwich Crown Court to the 2022 Rockstar hack that leaked about 90 early GTA 6 clips and to other offences - Rockstar / Take-Two put recovery costs near $5M (a claim not tested in court); sentencing later (PC Gamer + Shacknews + Aftermath) - studio rule: no 2022 leak images

Cyberleek claims modders could get GTA 6 running on PC within a week from his alleged Xbox build (TweakTown) - no evidence / no PC version exists (F005) / build files are linked to malware (F192) - studio rule: no Cyberleek content; Take-Two has since had the main unofficial port project taken down (F229)

Patch 01.002.002 notes (Nov 23): fixes several issues that caused crashes (not named) / weather that stopped changing for long periods / autosaves / phone calls that failed to trigger incl. some that progress the story or unlock missions / being unable to lose a Wanted Level (Push Square + Vice + PlayStation LifeStyle + Dot Esports); still the latest patch on Nov 28 07:15 UTC
Two more fixes in the Nov 23 patch listed only by PlayStation LifeStyle and games.gg: the gym deadlift bar and partners not handing bags over to fences
The Nov 23 patch adds no new content and its notes do not mention the first-person view (F161 / F162) / Series S performance (F128) / any 60 fps or performance mode
An unpatched 'Xbox 60fps glitch' is mentioned in patch roundups that attribute it to GamesRadar - no primary article found and no outlet shows it working

Alinea Analytics estimates about 44.9M copies sold by the end of the opening weekend (~$4B) - US 32.8% / France 9% / UK 7.3% - an analyst estimate not a Take-Two figure (official: 32.5M pre-release units - F166); no newer estimate or official total found Nov 28

The dark vignette around the screen edges is intentional: Rockstar VP of Art Michael Kane told Wccftech it is an artistic choice with no toggle and that a bug that made it stronger than intended was fixed (single-outlet interview - no second outlet found Nov 25)

Rockstar confirmed tropical storms and hurricanes plus localized persistent weather (recently showered areas stay wet with lasting puddles); GamesRadar reports weather rocks boats / damages planes / sends NPCs to shelter - hurricane frequency is unknown (Dexerto + GamingBolt + GamesRadar)
Fishing is catch-and-release only - fish cannot be kept or sold unlike hunting which pays cash (Rob Nelson via Notebookcheck); Shacknews says fishing is available from the start

A 'tested and working' unlimited money glitch (loot respawn after save and reload - Beebom) - Beebom itself calls it unreliable and games.gg / Rankedboost say no GTA 6 money glitch is confirmed; not mentioned in the Nov 23 patch notes

GTA 6 is banned in 8 countries / in the Gulf - the list on PlayStation's GTA 6 FAQ excludes those countries from the free GTA+ month not from the game; Tajikistan is the one formal ban (on the whole GTA series since 2024) (GTABoom + News of Bahrain)

Guides promising a 60 or 120 fps unlock on PS5 / Xbox via NVIDIA or AMD frame generation - the consoles have no NVIDIA GPU and accept no user-installed frame-generation tools; Rockstar targets 30 fps on every console (F051) and the Nov 23 patch adds no performance mode (F208)
The Nov 23 patch rolled out in waves - about a third of PS5 owners first and everyone within about six hours (dataminer via Wccftech)

GTA 6 debuted at No. 1 on the UK boxed retail chart (GfK) for its launch week ending Nov 21 ahead of EA Sports FC 27 - even though the boxed edition has no disc (F009); no unit figure was published (VGChartz + Nintendo Life + Games Asylum); the week-2 chart (week ending Nov 28 incl. Black Friday) is not published yet as of Nov 28 07:15 UTC (UK charts usually land early the following week)
Amazon UK showed 40K+ sales for the PS5 version alone in GTA 6's launch week (Games Asylum only - Amazon gives no exact count)

Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick said Take-Two has no plan to discount GTA 6 over the holidays and pointed to GTA 5's long price stability - retailers can still cut their own price but they 'reduce their margin' (GamingBolt + IBTimes UK + MP1st)

Black Friday / Thanksgiving week: no GTA 6 price cut on the PlayStation Store or Xbox Store (still $79.99 / $99.99) - only small retailer offers such as about 5% off the Xbox digital key at Fanatical and UK shops around 64.99 GBP vs the 69.99 GBP RRP (Currys / Argos); the Best Buy offers are reward certificates and points not a lower price (Beebom + Gaming Bible + Game Rant + PC Guide - live store pages not checked; no report of an official store cut on Black Friday morning Nov 27)

GTA 6 got an official Black Friday price cut from Rockstar / PlayStation / Xbox - Take-Two says it will not discount it over the holidays (F220) and the official stores still list $79.99 / $99.99 (F221); Game Rant's 'first official Black Friday discount' headline describes Best Buy reward offers not a lower sticker price

Free GTA 6 copies after an 'account verification' and ultra-cheap GTA 6 keys - Malwarebytes found a 'free copy' site that leads to a fake Google sign-in page to steal logins and McAfee warns that any free download or crack is a scam since there is no PC or mobile version (F005); re-checked Nov 26: McAfee's post-launch scam post and GB News repeat the warning (fake downloads stealing bank details) - no newer specific campaign found

You must finish 100% of GTA 6's story to unlock GTA 6 Online - the claim came from a self-described satirical news account on X (Community Note) and Rockstar has announced no GTA 6 Online mode / date or requirement (F012 / F036) (Mashable via Yahoo Tech)

Rockstar is fast-tracking GTA 6 Online amid player backlash (Express Tribune citing unnamed insiders) - no Rockstar statement and Schreier earlier reported Take-Two is not planning to talk soon about the new GTA Online

The IWGB union recognition ballot for 1600+ Rockstar UK workers ran Nov 12-26 2026 right over the GTA 6 launch - recognition only (no strike); it closed Nov 26 and the result announced that day was a clear No (about 75% against - see F236) so no union is formally recognised (PC Gamer + Dexerto + Game Developer + IBTimes UK + Kotaku)

Vehicle count: Kotaku reported fans had catalogued 272 GTA 6 vehicles from marketing by Sep 1 vs 252 in GTA 5 at launch (GTA Base data) - post-launch fan databases list about 319-360 and Rockstar has given no official count

Property: story safehouses cannot be bought - the only purchasable property is garages sold in the Vice City Real Estate phone app from Chapter 2 (8 garages from $4000 to $40000 / about $160000 for all / one car each / a trophy for buying all 8) - VGC's property guide plus PowerPyx / Beebom / games.gg; some guides saw 7 listings at first

Take-Two had GitHub disable 'Leonida' - an unofficial project to run a leaked Xbox build of GTA 6 on Windows - plus its whole fork network of about 3007 repositories via a DMCA notice citing Section 2.3 of Rockstar's terms (no decompiling or reverse engineering) and calling its 'bring your own files' defence misleading; the project's Discord was also shut (heise + TweakTown + Kotaku + Notebookcheck + KitGuru); no newer mass takedown reported as of Nov 28 - studio rule: no leak content or images

GTA 6 is now playable on PC thanks to a fan port - there is no official PC version (F005 / F035); unofficial builds run off leaked files and reportedly reach only about 2-5 fps (Notebookcheck) - a later fan build that claimed about 25 fps went offline after about an hour (PC Games Hardware) and a viral 'mod menu' clip is unverified (F239) - while Take-Two is taking them down (F229) and downloads sold as leaked builds are linked to malware (F040 / F192)

GTA 6 has a built-in photo mode called Photo Studio opened from the pause menu with pro-style camera and lighting tools - TechRadar reports some players now spend more time in it than on missions (TechRadar + Insider Gaming)

Photo Studio details from guides only: available from the very start of the game / can hide your character / cannot change the time of day or the weather; the phone camera is separate (selfies / up to 5x zoom / 17 filters) (Beebom + Gfinity + games.gg - no second reliable outlet)

Take-Two shares fell almost 4% on launch day despite the record numbers and Take-Two kept its FY2027 net bookings outlook of about $8.0B-$8.2B - Fortune (Nov 25) says investors still want more (Fortune + heise - not checked against market data; see F017 / F144)

Japan: no Famitsu boxed sales figure for GTA 6 found as of Nov 28 (Gematsu / VGChartz Famitsu pages for launch week not found); a PlatPrices snapshot put GTA 6 No. 1 on the PS Store best-seller chart in 46 of 47 tracked markets - Japan was the exception with free-to-play Apex Legends first and GTA 6 the top paid game (Rockstar Report + Analytics Insight + TechJuice - snapshot date unclear); Japan's boxed edition has a code and no disc so Famitsu physical counts may understate it (F009 / F063)

How the free GTA 6 scam works: Malwarebytes found a site promising a free GTA 6 copy after an account verification that leads to a fake Google sign-in page built to steal your login (McAfee and GB News repeat the warning)

Rockstar UK staff rejected IWGB union recognition: 1163 voted no and 381 yes (about 75% against) on a 93.2% turnout of 1544 voters across Edinburgh / Leeds / Lincoln / Dundee / London - result announced Nov 26; Rockstar's head of publishing Jennifer Kolbe said it reflects support for direct relationships and open dialogue while the IWGB says it will keep organising without recognition; separate from the dispute over 31 UK staff fired in Oct 2025 (Kotaku + Engadget + Yahoo News)

A leaked Rockstar press release dates GTA 6 Online for March 2027 on all platforms - the viral image is reported as AI-made and its own last line says Rockstar has not announced a date for GTA VI Online; nothing on Rockstar Newswire and no GTA 6 Online date exists (F012 / F036) (TalkEsport + 217gs + The Game Extras); re-checked Nov 28: no new evidence either way and still no Rockstar or Take-Two statement on GTA 6 Online

A GameGPU post (Nov 25) claims GTA 6 reaches PC in March 2027 together with GTA 6 Online - no Rockstar or Take-Two announcement (shattered.io: one leak and zero confirmations); older reports only point to Q1 2027 (F035)

A 24-second viral clip (Nov 26) shows a 'Viper' mod menu spawning cars and weapons in an unofficial PC port of GTA 6 - unverified and it shows no install or distribution; there is no official PC version (F005) - studio rule: no leak or port footage

GTA 6 has 55 trophies on PS5 (1 Platinum / 2 Gold / 6 Silver / 46 Bronze) and the same 55 achievements worth 1000 Gamerscore on Xbox; all are single-player and the Platinum needs every other trophy (Vice + Insider Gaming + GGRecon + GTABase - live PSN list not checked)

Trophy details from guides only: 28 of the 55 are hidden (mostly story) / the Platinum is named 'Vice Got A Price!' / PowerPyx estimates about 200 hours and 4/10 difficulty (PowerPyx + GTABase + KeenGamer) - a different fake list of 55 also circulated Nov 7-10

Accessibility and HUD options per guides: subtitles are off by default (Settings > UI > Subtitles & Captions with size / speaker names / background) / UI text size up to X Large / screen narration / high contrast / tinnitus reduction / mono audio / hold-to-toggle inputs - guides disagree on menu locations and no reliable outlet lists them yet (games.gg + Beebom + Player.One)
Hold Circle (PS5) / B (Xbox) in a car to duck out of sight so police are less likely to identify the driver (Push Square secret-controls guide + MP1st - only one outlet from the reliable list)

Loadout limit: you carry at most two long guns and two pistols on your person (GTA 5 let you carry dozens through the weapon wheel) and 30+ weapons have been seen so far - guides only and Rockstar gave no weapon count

Listening to the radio on foot (F199) uses headphones or earbuds bought for your character per guides; a former Rockstar tech lead says the team tried a similar headphones idea for GTA Vice City in 2002 (GamesRadar Nov 25 - single outlet; Rockstar only confirmed on-foot radio)

Food and exercise change Jason's and Lucia's bodies: eating a lot makes them heavier and working out builds and tones muscle (Rockstar to Dazed - reported by Kotaku + TweakTown + GamingBolt); after launch a player showed a max-weight 'True Fat Jason' reached on a steady burger-and-taco diet and an 'Overweight Strong' build mixing max weight and max muscle (Kotaku + Notebookcheck Nov 19) - Lucia's change looks less drastic per Kotaku; no official maximum and no confirmed gameplay effect

The body system returns from GTA San Andreas (2004) where CJ got fat or muscular - GTA 5 tracked skill stats such as stamina and strength but Michael / Franklin / Trevor never changed body shape (Kotaku: Rockstar confirms GTA 6 is bringing back the San Andreas weight system + TweakTown)

Sleep and fatigue: long stretches without sleep make Jason and Lucia look visibly exhausted and may hurt stamina (Rockstar to Dazed says they look exhausted - the stamina effect is media speculation); guides add the whole body system is optional and never blocks the story (Beebom + GamingBolt + allthings.how)

Motion blur can be lowered or turned off: Settings > Display > Motion Blur Strength is a slider from 0 to 10 - default 3 and 0 switches it off (Engadget - which notes motion blur can trigger motion sickness - + BGR; same values in KeenGamer and games.gg guides)

Some OLED TV owners say a middling motion blur level (about 4 to 6 - GameGPU suggests 7) makes the 30 fps image look less choppy while others prefer 0 - player anecdotes collected by TechRadar which advises trying both; motion blur adds no real frames (F051)

Other settings guides suggest changing first: Camera Shake off in the Camera tab and combat / player-status screen effects lowered to about 2-3 in the Display tab (KeenGamer + games.gg + fdaytalk - no outlet from the reliable list)

GTA 5 baseline for radio comparisons: it launched in 2013 with 17 radio stations and more than 240 songs (Red Bull) and Guinness World Records lists 21 stations for GTA V counting later additions - GTA 6 has no official station total (F200)

Activities seen in official screenshots and footage: pool / mini-golf / basketball / fishing / kayaking / boxing / playable arcade cabinets - no full golf course / playable tennis / bowling / darts confirmed (tennis courts appear as scenery); guides count 25 to 33+ side activities (GTABase + Gfinity + allthings.how - no reliable outlet has a full post-launch list)
